city.name: Istanbul
city.source_note: Euromonitor Top 100 City Destinations Index (#5 Global Arrivals) & Turkish Ministry of Culture and Tourism

attractions.name: Hagia Sophia (Ayasofya)
attractions.description: Sixth-century Byzantine architectural masterpiece with a massive dome and golden mosaics, later an Ottoman imperial mosque.

attractions.name: The Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque)
attractions.description: Seventeenth-century Ottoman imperial mosque famous for its six minarets and over 20,000 handmade blue Iznik tiles.

attractions.name: Topkapi Palace Museum
attractions.description: Primary residence and administrative court of the Ottoman Sultans for 400 years overlooking the Bosphorus.

attractions.name: Basilica Cistern (Yerebatan Sarnici)
attractions.description: Subterranean 6th-century Byzantine water cistern supported by 336 marble columns and two Medusa head bases.

attractions.name: Galata Tower
attractions.description: Medieval stone watchtower built by the Genoese in 1348 offering 360-degree views of the Golden Horn and Bosphorus.

attractions.name: Dolmabahce Palace
attractions.description: Opulent 19th-century Ottoman palace on the Bosphorus blending European Baroque, Rococo, and Neoclassical styles.

attractions.name: Suleymaniye Mosque
